subtitulo: Quality audits and pre-shipment control with photo and video reporting.
descripcion: We verify on-site that the factory exists, operates, and meets what was agreed before your order leaves origin.
queHacemos: Factory Audit to assess infrastructure and labor compliance
During-production inspection (DUPRO) to catch issues early
Pre-shipment inspection (PSI) based on AQL statistical sampling tables
Container Loading Check to prevent damage during loading
Detailed technical report with high-resolution photos and video in under 24 hours

beneficios.descripcion: Don't release the remaining balance until quality compliance is confirmed.
Globally recognized technical criteria (AQL level II / defect tolerances).
We verify the real state of the production floor, with no staged setups.
Receive the detailed verdict the same day as the factory visit.

etapas.detalle: Coordinating access with plant management in China.
Line inspection, piece count, and functional testing.
Random box extraction to verify tolerances and labeling.
Pass/Fail verdict with a complete multimedia report.

specs.Reporte: Technical PDF with high-resolution photos, measurements, and test videos
specs.Tiempos de entrega: Preliminary report in 12h, final report in 24h

pendiente: Confirm whether the inspection report includes photos/video.
